plain: What remains after parts are taken away, as of an estate

webster.text: That which remains after a part is taken, separated, removed or designated.

example.quote: The representatives thus elected, shall serve for the term of two years; and, in case of the death of a representative, or removal from office, the governor shall issue a writ to the county or township for which he was a member, to elect another in his stead, to serve for the residue of the term.
